flags.why: Nghỉ is the archaic third-person pronoun in this example; làm lấy expresses doing something oneself.
The common noun meaning pupil or student is missing, although it occurs in everyday expressions about teachers and students.
flags.fix: Add noun sense: pupil; student. Example: Thầy có nhiều trò giỏi. = The teacher has many good students.

flags.why: Thề does not mean swear words or profanity as a noun; chửi thề is the expression meaning to swear or use profanity.
Tấm in expressions such as tấm lòng is ordinary contemporary usage, so the literary tag mislabels the example.
Bóng commonly means a light bulb, an everyday sense missing from the entry.
flags.fix: Add noun sense: light bulb. Example: Tôi cần thay bóng đèn này. = I need to replace this light bulb.

flags.why: The disparaging use illustrated by lão ta needs a derogatory warning rather than only an informal tag.
